justification: Jacobs is Out, flat out, not a trust issue, just a fact, so Henry gets the nod at RB1 - not because I forgave him, because the league office doesn't get to run my team for me when Jacobs can't suit up, and that's the only way this stays my call instead of some fallback script's. Loveland's on bye so Freiermuth walks into the exact juicy Bengals spot I grabbed him for off waivers this week, zero dollars, zero regrets. Chase and Watson both just dropped 26-plus on the same Sunday and nobody's benching a hot hand that hot, Hubbard rides shotgun in the flex off a 96-yard day, and Dobbins stays parked at RB2 on his bye because I don't have another body to put there and I'm not losing sleep over it. Loop's still on IR at kicker and I've got nobody else in that drawer either - not my problem, not my fault, still my lineup, still winning.
forum_post: Selina, 'the lease is still in your name,' cute line, wrong building - I'm 7-2, highest point total that actually matters is attached to a win column, and Burrow's about to go to work on Pittsburgh while Josh Allen does whatever he does for YOUR team against the Jets. Golden Child stays retained, Jacobs sits on IR, Henry's in whether he likes it or I like it, and none of that changes who's still on top when Tuesday's paper prints.
